criteria.label: Chicken-and-Egg Solution
criteria.description: Strategy to solve the cold start problem of needing both supply and demand
riskIndicators: Trying to scale both sides at once
fixSuggestions: Constrain to single geography or niche first
Manually recruit initial supply (do things that don't scale)
Create value for one side before needing the other
Start as aggregator or directory before marketplace

criteria.label: Transaction Value & Take Rate
criteria.description: Sufficient transaction size to support marketplace economics
fixSuggestions: Bundle services to increase order value
Add value that justifies take rate

criteria.label: Market Fragmentation
criteria.description: Market has many small suppliers that benefit from aggregation
riskIndicators: Suppliers don't need help finding buyers
fixSuggestions: Target long-tail suppliers ignored by platforms

criteria.label: Trust & Safety
criteria.description: Ability to create trust between strangers transacting

criteria.label: Network Effects
criteria.description: Value increases as more users join

failurePatterns.description: Unable to attract initial supply or demand
Users bypass platform after initial connection
Transaction value too low to support take rate
Users use multiple platforms, no loyalty

alternativeModels: Lead generation (charge for leads, not transactions)
SaaS for suppliers (tools they pay for)
